title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:95638), Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k),Transfer Info:Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 ->FLAC -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC; amd Audience (shnid:113826), AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone;

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show captured on an excellent‑sounding matrix with standout performances of Mexicali Blues, Peggy‑O, Bird Song and more.
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the scorching hot setlist – from a soaring Mexicali Blues to an unforgettable Peggy‑O, Bird Song, Estimated Prophet and Stella Blue – all delivered with high energy and tight playing. The matrix source is praised as crystal‑clear and one of the best mixes available for this concert, making it both a musical and technical treat.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars), highlighting both superb show energy and an excellent‑quality matrix recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a very nice sounding matrix; no dropouts or muddiness noted, praised for clarity and balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, varied openings (Iko Iko, Man Smart) lead into a high‑octane first set; the second set maintains momentum with dynamic peaks and smooth transitions.
